# Matt Santi

> "Transform your midlife crisis into your greatest comeback using the Hero's Journey Framework and 8-step inside-out change system."

Matt Santi is a career transition and personal transformation coach specializing in midlife reinvention for professionals 40+. The site offers an 8-step guided framework, an exclusive member portal, interactive goal-setting tools, and a published book—all designed to help individuals discover their true calling and execute meaningful life changes.

## Key Topics

- Hero's Journey Framework
- 8-Step Transformation System
- Midlife Reset
- Career Transition
- Personal Transformation
- Inside-Out Change
- Self-Discovery
- Life Coaching
- 40+ Audience
- Professional Development
- Member Portal
- Goal Setting
- SMART Goals
- Joseph Campbell
- Growth Guild Newsletter

- [Matt Santi – The "Inside-Out Change" Agent](https://mattsanti.com): Homepage introducing Matt Santi's 8-step midlife transformation system and Hero's Journey Framework
